1.consolidated_definition: dep. Agarre. Abrazo fuerte en una pelea de boxeo. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. El caso es que las autoridades se percataron de la movida y tuvieron que separarlos (ni que fuera un clinch como en el boxeo), con el saldo de que ya él no podrá recibir visitas privadas (El Mundo de Luis Daniel Beltrán, blog, 09-05-04)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Clinch (n.) 
Holding or clinch in a boxing match; a strong hug or hold in a fight. 
Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. The authorities became aware of the situation and had to separate them (even if it was just a clinch like in boxing), resulting in him no longer being able to receive private visits.
